purpose: 시각 자료의 적격성, 비교 가능성, 불확실성, 관찰 지표를 비보상적 순서로 표현하는 재사용 후보의 책임을 기술한다.
expectedOutcome: 도메인 프로필이 공급자·장소·임계값·선호 차원을 주입하더라도 필수 실패와 증거 부족이 비교값으로 가려지지 않는 보고 전용 판정 기록
owns: visual evidence acceptance and rejection vocabulary
mandatory qualifying comparative observational decision order
mustNotOwn: agent assignment acceptance promotion or final user choice

outputs: comparison results separated from observations and limitations
interfaces.compatibility: This report-only candidate has no public runtime consumer; future adoption requires a source-managed schema revision and explicit profile migration.

reviewTriggers: a second independent domain or provider uses the same stable responsibility
false acceptance or false rejection evidence appears
lifecycle.failure: Retain the task-local profile and surface unavailable or conflicting evidence without publishing a reusable unit.
lifecycle.recovery: Change one bounded finding fingerprint, freeze the candidate, and validate representative positive negative ambiguous conflicting and recovery cases.
lifecycle.rollback: Remove the report-only candidate binding and keep the cafe task profile self-contained.
lifecycle.supersession: A source-managed owner may replace the candidate only with explicit version compatibility and migration evidence.
lifecycle.retirement: Retire when an existing rubric owner fully covers the responsibility or cross-context evidence does not justify maintenance cost.

limitations: Only one cafe-selection task and one image provider have been observed.
No independent cross-domain consumer or accepted field outcome exists.
The candidate has no source-managed schema or deterministic standalone checker.
counterevidence: Engineering Decision Rubric already owns the four criterion kinds and non-compensatory decision semantics.
A task-local profile may remain clearer and cheaper than a new shared contract.
